alt: A quiet residential street with low buildings, trees and paving, lit by an even daylight.
A grassy lakeside park with a path to the water, low housing on both sides and the distant city curving up.
A knoll top above a round spring pool, with meadow and trees running away toward the end wall of the rotor.
A shallow stream between grassy banks with a line of stepping stones, the knoll rising upstream and the city beyond.
A narrow stream stepping down between mossy banks and a stone path under trees.
A small waterfall dropping into a plunge pool beside a grassed berm, with towers and the curve of the city rising behind.
A cluster of tall crowned towers and spires rising above a park lawn, with the curve of the city beyond.
A massive structural rib rising out of a groundside neighborhood, with houses and streets at its feet.
A raised plate district with a balustrade, planters, block rows and a truss bridge, and the opposite city overhead.
A tall open atrium of long-span steel framing with sparse process facilities and hazy air above a city below.
A planted cliff-like end wall with stepped ledges and struts above a train viaduct, rising toward the sky.
A terrace on a tall wall with a balustrade, trailing vines, a glazed hall and a train track above the city.
A garden balcony high on a tall wall with a handrail and benches, looking down over a city under the sky.
Concentric ledge rings with vaulted halls and gardens on a curved end wall, thinning toward the axis.
A broad plaza with a ring sculpture and the boarding lift entrance at the base of a tall tower.
Racks of leafy crops under LED rigs along a long grow deck, with nutrient channels and a gantry above.
A belt line of crop totes passing a wash tunnel, an optical sorter and a weigher in a bright process hall.
A loading dock with crates of salad, trays of bread, bottles and pallets being loaded onto freight pods.
A view from an ascender cabin at 250 m above a neighborhood, with the city horizon rising on all sides.
An ascender cabin rises through the open floor of the artificial sky, with a curved city and lit ceiling stretching away.
A panoramic cabin interior with window seats, rails and a glass floor gallery, and a city curving beyond.
A tall lattice tower with cabins on three tracks, seen from 140 m beside it at 800 m altitude.
A large rotating drum behind a bearing collar, with four tower portals and spin-decoupling chambers.
The inside of a cylindrical lock with viewing slots, door portals, a carousel and an amber indicator ring.
A slender stationary tube in the foreground with a rotating city turning around it in the distance.
A long lit tube interior with ring frames, a guideway on stays, crew galleries and AXIS 01 signboards.
A vacuum gap between two huge rotor ends with bearings, service frames and connections visible.
A long truss bridge with window bands and X bracing spanning the gap between two rotor ends.
A bridge interior with a promenade, a guideway and shuttle, window bands and a distant pressure door.
The interface between two rotor ends spinning opposite ways, with a stationary frame and seals between them.
A car interior with restraint couches, grab rails, net lockers and a destination display above the door.
A five-car express on a guideway inside the spine, seen from ahead of the head car.
A glass-walled gallery at the end of a platform, looking aft along a long bore to a service port.
A huge bearing assembly with a turning sleeve and rim, catchers, alignment actuators and a seal labyrinth.
A hall of high-voltage valve buildings, capacitor banks and cooling headers seen through arched windows.
Two large hubs of opposed spin around a stationary spine, with bearing machinery between them.
A bay with four large ring housings, catwalks and bearing stacks along a stationary spine.
The underside of a massive spinning ring in its housing, with stators, bearings and coolant pipes.
A wide open truss frame with cargo racks, spherical tanks and robots in a rotating industrial structure.
Glass-faced grow galleries glowing white and magenta beside tanks, pipework and air handlers high in the city.
A large spacecraft hull held inside a vast construction volume by tension lines, rings and tugs.
A cutaway crew drum with stacked decks, capture arms, a robotic manipulator and a small capsule.
A large tank approaching a cradle on tension lines, with crawlers, tugs and umbilicals around it.
A raised metro platform with screen doors, a canopy and a train set standing at the platform.
A street at eye height with an elevated viaduct on portals overhead and the line running away along it.
A glass lift tower with a canopy at the street door and a long shaft rising to a viaduct above.
A large terminal hall in zero gravity with signage, public structure and docking bays beyond.
The arrival rotunda: a monumental arch under a lit WELCOME TO CONCORDIA sign at the head of the terminal nave.
The concourse deck low in the nave: shop pods, travellers, a catch-net ring and handline riders overhead.
A gate with its boarding bridge and berth frame holding a docked passenger craft.
Three rotating lounge wheels on stationary hubs, seen across a concourse.
A long truss pier on the outside of the end face with a freighter and tugs alongside.
A long passenger cabin with rows of couches, a window band and aisle lighting.
A long straight track on a ridge with coil modules and gantries running along the station hull.
An ivory shuttle parked on the launch track beside blue edge lights, floodlight masts and a bay sign on the station hull.
The cabin of a parked shuttle with cream panelling, a bronze shelter door and the first rows of acceleration couches.
The cabin of the shuttle parked in bay 2 with cream panelling, a bronze shelter door and the first rows of couches.
The cabin of the shuttle parked in bay 3 with cream panelling, a bronze shelter door and the first rows of couches.
The full length of the station as a grey cylinder with radiators and structure against black space.
An open bay in a station shell revealing a rotating industrial truss with cargo and tanks.
A huge circular port frame with spokes, pier rings and a terminal structure at its centre.
A view through a gridded cage of frames and ribs to a large spacecraft in a yard.
A sunlit station silhouette from far off, with radiator banks and a port on the end against black space.
A cluster of foil-covered spherical tanks with sunshades, radiators and transfer lines on the outer face.
A field of huge flat radiator panels on pylons above the hull, with the habitat scale visible below.
A large dish on a lattice tower with a turntable, a hut and small arrays on the hull.
An armoured launcher housing with hazard apron, blast wall and a sensor group beyond.
A tethered solar farm with a large photovoltaic field and the station's aft face beyond.
A dark structure outlined by a dozen work lamps, a bus and a truss against black space.
A long truss with two solar wings and a thruster plate, towing a metal asteroid cinched in a net bag, against black space.
The hauler's thruster plate and propellant tanks in the foreground, the truss and solar wings running away toward the bag.
A ribbed station end face with red rim lights, a central tower and tall masts against black space.
Four tall masts with cables running aft from the end of a station.
A tall mast carrying a reactor behind a shield, with thin radiator petals edge-on to the light.
A ring of shielded thruster pods canted outward around a station's end face.
A pressure sphere of armour and window cells on the rim of the aft tower, with a tube running back to the drum edge.
Inside the aft observatory, looking aft through the pole window past the grab pole and the cocoons.
A huge armoured station receding behind a departing craft against black space.
The station in the foreground with Earth and the Moon as small discs at their true apparent size.
The momentum control bay with engineering overlay labels beside four ring housings and the stationary spine.
The whole station in space with gravity overlay labels marking 1 g at the ground and near zero at the axis.
